summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim results for Q3 and the nine months ended September 30, 2026, via press release and report exhibits. Q3 TCE earnings were USD 353m versus USD 236m a year earlier, EBITDA USD 274m, and net profit USD 199m, with basic EPS of USD 1.94. A quarterly dividend of USD 1.35 per share was declared, a 75% payout ratio. The release also notes selective newbuilding investments and vessel sales. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation.
